description: analogRead against fixed voltages, with the default and the internal reference.
basis: ATmega328P datasheet 24.7: ADC = floor(Vin * 1024 / Vref) limited to 1023, Vref = VCC (5 V) for DEFAULT and 1.1 V for INTERNAL; computed by hand: 2.51 V -> 514, 0 V -> 0, 5 V -> 1023, 1.1 V -> 225, 0.6 V -> 122 (DEFAULT) and 558 (INTERNAL)
